pages.title: Biochar — farm waste to black gold

facts.text: Production: pyrolysis — oxygen-depleted heating at 300–700°C; by-products syngas and bio-oil
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: ⚠ Decomposes very slowly (stores carbon for centuries)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Benefits: water-holding +10–25%; yield +10–30%; 1 t biochar sequesters 2.5–3 t CO2e
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Carbon credits: VM0042 methodology — 2–2.8 t CO2e credits per tonne; KISAN kiln by IIT Kharagpur
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: India: crop waste 500 MT+/yr; Punjab–Haryana burn 20 MT+ paddy straw; MSW 62 MT (50%+ biodegradable)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Potential: syngas 20–30 MT (8–13 TWh); bio-oil 24–40 MT (substitutes 12–19 MT diesel/kerosene)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Concrete: 2–5% biochar — heat resistance +20%, captures ~115 kg CO2/m³
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Trials: Akola (maize stalk, black soil); Kerala (coconut leaf stalk); abroad — Kenya (rice husk), Thailand, Brazil (Embrapa)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: PYQ (2020): biochar in vertical farming — aids N-fixing microbes, retains water (all correct)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Cause: Omega Block — high pressure between two lows, shaped like Ω; stalls the jet stream (west-to-east)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Heat dome: sinking, compressed air under the high; ⚠ suppresses clouds and rain
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: France: 18 heat deaths, 40 drownings; alerts in France, UK, Spain, Italy
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Europe: warming at more than twice the global rate — fastest-warming continent
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Concepts: climate whiplash (rapid swing between extremes); albedo loss from Arctic ice; tropical night; urban heat island
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: El Niño: developing — raises probability (⚠ not certainty) of weak Indian monsoon
facts.head: Facts

pages.title: Tunnels, passes and rivers in news

facts.text: Item: Zojila Tunnel; Fact: 13.153 km; J&K–Ladakh; world's highest road tunnel under construction; India's longest bi-directional single-tube road tunnel; 11,578 ft, Baltal–Minamarg; built by MEIL for NHIDCL
facts.head: Tunnels and passes

facts.text: Item: Photu La Tunnel; Fact: Approved on Srinagar–Leh NH-01; ₹1,196.22 crore; 2.65 km (1.96 km twin-tube + 0.69 km approach roads); cuts 8.5 km; Photu La — highest pass on the highway (~4,108 m)
facts.head: Tunnels and passes

facts.text: Item: Lipulekh Pass; Fact: India–China border trade resumed after 6 years (suspended 2020, COVID-19); near India–Nepal–China tri-junction; Kailash–Manasarovar route; new customs office at Gunji; links Pithoragarh with Purang (Taklakot); ~5,200 m; ⚠ first India–China trading point opened (1992); others — Shipki La (HP), Nathu La (Sikkim)
facts.head: Tunnels and passes
